title: Tech view: the 'Send to Portal' button is hidden
preconds: 1. A user has a role with View mode set to Tech view, the Customer portal toggle ON, and Review work orders ON.
steps:
1. Log in as that user.
  2. Open a work order that has a line eligible to send to the portal.
  3. Look for a Send to Portal button on the work order and on the line.
  4. Check the work order header, the action menu, and the line-level actions.
expected: The Send to Portal button is not shown anywhere on the work order — not in the header, on the line, or in the action menus.
